items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I don't know whether he and Lionel Hampton ever met... I heard Lionel Hampton doing the same thing.

ctx.x: Okay, and you said there was a controversy about whether or not Baby Louis taught Lionel Hampton to play drums and vibes. Now, off the tape you said it was generally accepted that he did. Then on the tape you said it was controversial about whether he did or not. What do you think? What did he say?
Well, I don't know, because Baby had traveled so much, you know, before I ever met him, that I don't know whether he and Lionel Hampton ever met. 'Cause, see,

Hamp came up around Chicago, you know? And Baby [Louis] came out of Kansas City. And I don't know if they were both doing the same thing at the same time, or who got what from who. But every time I heard Baby [Louis,] he was doing it before I ever heard of --
